tasks.title: Session child cleanup
tasks.description: Unregister closed Present windows from the deck session graph and exclude them from directed sends so the UI and program state stay consistent.

tasks.title: End blank program state
tasks.description: Route End through the main-owned deck session so it sends a directed blank payload to the selected Present children and clears the presenter viewport state. Ensure Deck state becomes blank and Start after End sends the first slide again.

tasks.title: Program thumbnail fidelity
tasks.description: Make the on-program preview derive from the same program state sent to Present, including messages, song lyric segments, green-screen behavior, and blank output after End. Move the preview into the Presentation controls region and verify updates for every navigation and send action.

tasks.title: Theme persistence relaunch
tasks.description: Persist the selected theme in a durable user-owned preference location rather than browser storage or the application working directory. Restore valid themes across full quit and relaunch for Home, deck, and Present while preserving live synchronization and safe fallback behavior.

tasks.title: Durable library storage
tasks.description: Use ~/.poster as the default durable library root, migrate existing cwd SQLite or JSON data once, and add settings to re-point the library without moving or deleting the old directory. Verify data survives cwd changes, application updates, and reinstall simulations.

tasks.title: Home regression guard
tasks.description: Add regression coverage proving Home does not expose a bare Open Present action and that Present windows are created only through the deck workflow. Preserve coverage for Home library actions and Open Presentation navigation.

tasks.title: Test harness and CI
tasks.description: Add the required unit, integration, and Playwright smoke coverage for theme relaunch, library migration and re-pointing, Present close cleanup, End blanking, program preview behavior, and the Home guard. Wire stable unit and integration suites into pull request CI and document isolated Electron relaunch coverage.

tasks.title: Acceptance documentation sync
tasks.description: Synchronize README.md, ralph/epic.md, the applicable epic plan, and requirements.md with the durable theme and library behavior, migration rules, re-pointing semantics, regression fixes, and verification status.
